title: Event Dossier Freeze Manifest
description: One freeze_manifest.json per event_labels.csv row that reaches label_status=human_frozen. Records the frozen Layer A artifact hashes, the freeze timestamp/actor, and every recorded Layer B/C reviewer exposure and reveal event, so reveal-before-freeze and exposure-before-freeze violations can be checked mechanically. See EVENT_DOSSIER_PROTOCOL_v0.1_DRAFT.md Section 17.

reviewer_capture_exposure_log.description: Every recorded instance of a reviewer being shown Layer B/C content for this event, regardless of when. Used to detect a disqualifying exposure: an entry here with exposure_timestamp_utc < freeze_timestamp_utc whose reviewer_id also appears as frozen_by is a validation failure.

reveal_events.description: Every recorded instance of Layer B/C content being formally revealed (as distinct from merely captured) for this event. Every revealed_at_utc here must be >= freeze_timestamp_utc.

amendment_of_manifest_path.description: Set if this manifest itself amends a prior frozen manifest for the same event (mirrors event_labels.amendment_of_label_id).
